title: Fabric extraction — what one artifact is about, in its own words

term.description: A concept the artifact is ABOUT, as a careful reader would say it. It need NOT appear in the text — naming what a document is about without using its words is the point.

evidence_span.description: A SHORT quotation from the excerpt, copied exactly. The term may be your reading; this may not. A span that is not present verbatim is discarded with its term.

salience.description: How central this is to the artifact. Distinct from how sure a MATCH is — a central term may still match no concept.
